description: This file declares an interface for iterating over reftable data structures, including methods for seeking, advancing, and destroying iterators, as well as referencing associated record types. It is likely part of a larger system managing reference data, such as in a version control context.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_ref
methods.description: Positions the iterator at the reference record with the specified name.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_next_ref
methods.description: Reads the next reference record; returns negative on error, zero on success, positive at end of iteration.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log_at
methods.description: Positions the iterator at the log record with the specified name and update index.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_seek_log
methods.description: Positions the iterator at the newest log record with the specified name.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_next_log
methods.description: Reads the next log record; returns negative on error, zero on success, positive at end.

methods.name: reftable_iterator_destroy
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the iterator.
